entrypoints.summary: The extension evaluates the current tab URL to suggest stored credentials, including a subdomain/parent-host comparison in canSuggestUrl.js.

affected_components.role: Current-tab URL versus stored credential URL matching; the report identifies the parent-host fallback call as affected code.

code_slices.fixed: No patch is present; the report recommends full-origin matching in the documented case.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The report says protocol, hostname, and port are compared before the additional subdomain check.
code_slices.vulnerable: canSuggestUrl delegates the fallback hostname decision to isParentHostname(suggestedUrlObject.hostname, urlObject.hostname).

negative_controls: A full-origin match should not treat an unrelated dotted hostname as equivalent to the stored single-label origin.
observability.positive_marker: The credential stored for the distinct single-label or root-level-TLD URL is suggested on the colliding site.

preconditions: A relevant credential is stored for a single-label intranet URL or directly accessible root-level TLD URL.
The user visits a dotted hostname with the stored single label as its terminal label.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: A hostname ending in dot plus the stored single DNS label.
trigger_steps.summary: Navigate the current tab to the documented colliding hostname, such as https://titan.email/, after storing a credential for https://email.

impact.affected_asset: Association between stored Passbolt credentials and their intended web origins.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause navigation to a hostname whose terminal label collides with a stored single-label or root-level-TLD credential URL and thereby obtain a suggestion opportunity.
impact.security_effect: Credential recommendation is displayed in an unrelated website origin context.

causal_trace.summary: A user has a stored credential URL with a single-label intranet hostname such as https://email, or an Internet-accessible root-level TLD URL such as http://ai/.

The suggestion logic compares protocol, hostname, and port and additionally accepts a current hostname as a subdomain of the stored hostname; isParentHostname returns true when the parent appears at the end of the child after a dot or nothing.

The call isParentHostname(suggestedUrlObject.hostname, urlObject.hostname) can classify the stored label email as a parent of titan.email because email is the terminal label of that unrelated hostname.

On visiting a colliding hostname such as https://titan.email/, the extension may suggest the credential stored for the distinct single-label or root-level-TLD URL; the report characterizes these as edge cases and rates the finding Low.

failure.operation: Hostname-parent comparison used as the fallback credential-suggestion decision

primary_invariant.statement: A credential stored for a single-label intranet host or a root-level TLD URL must not be suggested for an unrelated dotted hostname merely because its terminal DNS label matches the stored hostname.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The parent-host suffix predicate accepts a parent at the end of a child hostname after a dot or no preceding character, conflating a stored single DNS label with a suffix authority for another hostname.

remediation.invariant_restored: Credential suggestions in the single-label/TLD edge case require full-origin equality rather than hostname suffix parentage.

avoid credential suggestions for the documented dotless-URL edge case
